description: A black power strip with several ports lies on the green bedspread in front of a dark blue pillow, with a white USB dongle and cables nearby. The left hand steadies the power strip from the left while the right hand moves in from the right to grasp the small white USB plug at the end of the dongle and pull it upward and away, unplugging it and letting the dongle drop onto the bed; then both hands hover over the power strip as the right hand adjusts the attached black cable.
